facts.fact: AfDB (French release): provisional acceptance on 14 Nov 2025 of fibre sections built under the AfDB-financed project: 1,031 km on five routes (Arlit-Assamaka to Algerian border; Diffa-N'Guigmi to Chad border; Zinder-Magaria to Nigeria border; Niamey-Dosso-Gaya to Benin border; Niamey-Makalondi to Burkina Faso border), built by the LORYNE group; commissioning is described as forthcoming, not yet done.
